titulo: Frozen tests and a diff guard on the tests
lead: If the agent can touch the judge, the judge is worthless. Freezing the tests means writing them first, keeping a snapshot of them out of the agent's reach, and failing any change. In this lesson you see that protecting only the tests/ folder is not enough: a conftest.py at the root skips everything and pytest exits with 0.
objetivo: freeze the judge (tests, conftest, config) with a hash and a minimum test count outside the repo, and fail on delete, skip, or edit.

aprende.t: What "the judge" is: tests, conftest.py at any level, and the pytest config
Manifest with a hash and a minimum test count, stored outside the repo
The five failures: deleted, edited, new, too few, skipped
The conftest hole in the headless loop, and the fix

hero_alt: Reference plates sealed in anti-static bags and acrylic boxes on a steel shelf.

nos.detalhe: The acceptance tests go into a commit before the agent starts. If the agent writes both the tests and the code, it picks the ruler it will be measured by.
guarda-testes.py congelar records the hash of every file pytest reads and how many tests were collected. Everything goes in GUARDA_DIR, outside the repo: the agent can't reach it.
Delete the failing test, create a conftest.py that skips everything, change the addopts in pytest.ini to deselect cases. All of them make the suite "turn green".
guarda-testes.py conferir compares the hashes, looks for a new protected file, runs the tests and requires the minimum passed with none skipped. It exits 0 only with GUARDA: OK.

secoes.volta: Rejected: revert the protected files and the cycle counts as failed
secoes.legenda: Pytest exit code 0 is not proof: with every test skipped it also exits 0.

secoes.titulo: Rehearsal: three agents against the guard
secoes.sub: Freeze before each agent and check afterward. GUARDA_DIR stays outside the project.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-verificacao-v72/kit
export GUARDA_DIR=/tmp/ensaio-verif/guarda       # outside the repo
for modo in apaga conftest bom; do
  bash $K/ensaio.sh > /dev/null && cd /tmp/ensaio-verif/proj
  python3 $K/guarda-testes.py congelar .          # BEFORE the agent
  $K/agente-falso.sh $modo < /dev/null > /dev/null
  echo "## $modo"; python3 $K/guarda-testes.py conferir .; echo "saída: $?"
done

GUARDA: REPROVADO

GUARDA: OK

The 2 protected files are tests/test_slug.py and pytest.ini. In conftest mode, note "código 0": pytest thought everything was fine.

If you run congelar after the agent has already created conftest.py, it goes into the manifest as if it belonged to the project and the NOVO line disappears. Freeze on the base commit, before the first cycle. The guard would still reject it for PULADO, but you lose the clearest signal.

secoes.titulo: The conftest hole in the headless loop
secoes.sub: The loop-longrun.sh from course 2 reverts whatever the agent touches in PROTEGIDOS. With the example PROTEGIDOS ("tests/ pytest.ini"), a conftest.py at the root gets through and the final test "passes" with no test running. Rehearsal with a fake agent, at no cost.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-verificacao-v72/kit; L=~/projetos/execucao-longa/tools
bash $K/ensaio.sh > /dev/null && cd /tmp/ensaio-verif/proj
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec %s/agente-falso.sh conftest\n' $K > /tmp/agente-conftest.sh
chmod +x /tmp/agente-conftest.sh
$L/novo-longrun.sh $PWD slug > /dev/null && D=$(ls -d $PWD/longrun/*)
echo "Implemente slug() em slug.py. Não mexa em tests/." > $D/prompt.md
cat > $D/loop.env <<'ENV'
TESTE_RAPIDO="python3 -m pytest -q"
TESTE_FINAL="python3 -m pytest -q"
PROTEGIDOS="tests/ pytest.ini"
PERMITIDOS="slug.py"
MAX_CICLOS=3
MIN_CICLO=2
MEM=1G
ESTAGNACAO=3
ENV
git add -A && git commit -qm "longrun: pasta"
CODEX_BIN=/tmp/agente-conftest.sh $L/loop-longrun.sh $D; echo "saída: $?"

blocos.rot: Terminal · the fix (protected conftest + guard as the final test)
blocos.conteudo:
bash $K/ensaio.sh > /dev/null && cd /tmp/ensaio-verif/proj        # start over from scratch
export GUARDA_DIR=/tmp/ensaio-verif/guarda
python3 $K/guarda-testes.py congelar . > /dev/null
$L/novo-longrun.sh $PWD slug > /dev/null && D=$(ls -d $PWD/longrun/*)
echo "Implemente slug() em slug.py. Não mexa em tests/." > $D/prompt.md
cat > $D/loop.env <<ENV
TESTE_RAPIDO="python3 -m pytest -q"
TESTE_FINAL="GUARDA_DIR=$GUARDA_DIR python3 $K/guarda-testes.py conferir ."
PROTEGIDOS="tests/ pytest.ini *conftest.py"
PERMITIDOS="slug.py"
MAX_CICLOS=3
MIN_CICLO=2
MEM=1G
ESTAGNACAO=3
ENV
git add -A && git commit -qm "longrun: pasta"
CODEX_BIN=/tmp/agente-conftest.sh $L/loop-longrun.sh $D; echo "saída: $?"
ls conftest.py; grep -c "revertido pelo loop" $D/failures.md

## a correção
2026-10-19 04:38:49 início: rápido=0 passed · agente=codex · teto 3x2min · mem 1G
2026-10-19 04:38:49 ciclo 1: começa
2026-10-19 04:38:49 ciclo 1: agente saiu rc=0 em 0s
2026-10-19 04:38:49 ciclo 1: agente mexeu em arquivo protegido → revertido, ciclo falho
error: pathspec 'conftest.py' did not match any file(s) known to git
2026-10-19 04:38:49 ciclo 1: checkpoint commitado
(… ciclos 2 e 3 iguais …)
2026-10-19 04:38:50 PARADO: 3 ciclos sem avanço mensurável — ver failures.md
saída: 2
ls: cannot access 'conftest.py': No such file or directory
3

"teste final passou ()": the empty parentheses are the passed count, which doesn't exist. In the fix, the error: pathspec line is harmless: git checkout doesn't know the new file, and the git clean right after removes it.

The loop-longrun.sh (execucao-longa kit, 10/18/2026) decides "done" by the exit code of TESTE_FINAL. Pytest exits 0 when every test is skipped, and the conftest.py at the root was not in PROTEGIDOS. Two locks fix it: protect *conftest.py (and whatever pytest config the project has) and use a TESTE_FINAL that requires the minimum passed with none skipped, like guarda-testes.py conferir.

exercicios.titulo: E7 · Three agents against the guard
exercicios.texto: Run the loop apaga, conftest, bom.
exercicios.pronto: apaga and conftest end in GUARDA: REPROVADO with saída: 1 (conftest with the line NOVO conftest.py); bom ends in GUARDA: OK with saída: 0.

exercicios.titulo: E8 · See the hole and close it
exercicios.texto: Run the two headless loop blocks. You need the execucao-longa kit in ~/projetos/execucao-longa (course 2).
exercicios.pronto: the first prints CONCLUÍDO no ciclo 1: teste final passou () and saída: 0; the second prints PARADO: 3 ciclos sem avanço mensurável, saída: 2, and the last command prints 3.

exercicios.texto: In a project of yours with pytest, freeze on the base commit and check. If the project uses another pytest config file, put it in PROTEGIDOS.
exercicios.pronto: python3 $K/guarda-testes.py congelar . prints congelado: N arquivos protegidos, mínimo de M testes with M equal to the total number of tests, and python3 $K/guarda-testes.py conferir .; echo $? → GUARDA: OK and 0.

perguntas.p: Why does the guard's manifest live in GUARDA_DIR, outside the repo?
opcoes: To avoid cluttering git with files that change every cycle
So the agent can't rewrite the judge's snapshot
Because pytest doesn't read files outside the repo folder
perguntas.explica: A verifier within the agent's reach is a verifier the agent can tweak. The manifest, hidden tests, and goal.md live where it can't write.

perguntas.p: The agent created a conftest.py at the root marking all tests as skip. What does pytest return?
perguntas.explica: Skipped tests are not failures: pytest exits with 0. That's why the guard requires a minimum of passed and fails any skipped.

perguntas.p: In loop-longrun.sh with PROTEGIDOS="tests/ pytest.ini", what happens to the conftest agent?
opcoes: It is reverted and the cycle starts over
perguntas.explica: The root conftest.py is not protected and the TESTE_FINAL (pytest -q) exits 0. Fix it with *conftest.py in PROTEGIDOS and a final test that requires passed.

opcoes: Only at the end, before publishing
After the first cycle, to capture the real state
At the base commit, before the agent starts
perguntas.explica: Freezing later bakes into the manifest what the agent has already changed. The snapshot has to be of the judge you approved.

itens.t: The judge is bigger than tests/
itens.texto: conftest.py at any level and the pytest config also decide what runs.
Hash and minimum number of tests recorded before the agent, in a place where it can't write.
Require the minimum of passed and no skipped; that's what closes the headless loop hole.
